name: H1B $1K One-Week Challenge

account.holder_profile: Indian citizen, US resident on H-1B
account.broker_model: US zero-commission broker, fractional shares allowed

execution_model.fill: Latest trade price from Yahoo Finance at execution time (regular or extended-hours print), adjusted for slippage
execution_model.sessions: Pre-market 4:00-9:30, regular 9:30-16:00, after-hours 16:00-20:00 ET. The 20:00-4:00 overnight session is not simulated (no reliable price feed).

blocked_lists: OFAC NS-CMIC (EO 14032) Chinese military-industrial complex securities
rules.note: Order caps are a runaway-loop fuse only. No legal cap on trade count applies to a personal account; H-1B limits are about employment: no trading for others, no pay, no trader-tax-status election.

benchmark_base_note: Regular-session closes on Mon Sep 28, 2026 (challenge accepted after that close)
